title: LinearRAG: Linear Graph Retrieval Augmented Generation on Large-scale Corpora
authors: Luyao Zhuang; Shengyuan Chen; Yilin Xiao; Huachi Zhou; Yujing Zhang; Hao Chen; Qinggang Zhang; Xiao Huang
why_relevant: Proposes a GraphRAG method that analyzes noise from relation extraction errors in knowledge graphs, touching tangentially on retrieval noise issues.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is improving graph construction efficiency and retrieval accuracy, not robustness to unreliable evidence, adversaries, or calibration.
